title: Customer Care Coordinator
description:
Customer Care Coordinator
Company: SME Residential Developer
Location: Watford
Salary: Up to £35k

About the Role
The Customer Care Coordinator will manage post-completion customer enquiries, coordinate defect resolution and maintain clear communication with residents throughout the aftercare process.
Cityscape is recruiting on behalf of a residential development business delivering new homes, with the role supporting customers following handover and coordinating remedial works with contractors and internal teams.

What You Will Do

As Customer Care Coordinator, you will coordinate customer service matters from initial notification through to satisfactory resolution.
- Manage customer enquiries and defects, recording issues accurately and keeping residents informed throughout the resolution process.
- Coordinate subcontractor appointments and remedial works, ensuring reported defects are progressed and completed within agreed timescales.
- Liaise with site teams, contractors and customers to arrange access and communicate planned repair appointments clearly.
- Maintain accurate customer care records, updating defect information, correspondence, appointments and completion status for each property.
- Monitor outstanding remedial works, following up contractors and escalating unresolved customer issues through the appropriate internal channels.
- Support customers professionally following handover, providing clear information on reported defects, appointments and progress towards resolution.

What You Bring
- Experience as a Customer Care Coordinator within residential development, housebuilding, construction aftercare.
- Demonstrate experience coordinating property defects and remedial works from initial customer report through to confirmed completion.
- Provide experience liaising directly with homeowners or residents regarding repairs, appointments, access arrangements and outstanding issues.
- Demonstrate experience coordinating subcontractors, trades and site teams to complete post-handover defect and customer care works.
- Provide experience maintaining accurate defect logs, customer correspondence and records across multiple properties and outstanding work items.
- Demonstrate experience handling customer complaints professionally while coordinating practical actions to resolve property-related issues effectively.

Desirable
- COINS experience
- Demonstrate experience working for a UK housebuilder or residential developer within a dedicated post-completion customer care team.
- Provide experience using customer relationship management or defect management systems to record queries, appointments and completed works.
- Demonstrate experience supporting customers during new-home warranty and post-completion defect periods within residential development.

title: Estates Administrator
description:
My established client are seeking an experienced Estates Administrator to work in this dynamic office.

You will be based in the Watford Office - (no hybrid working available) Monday - Friday 9am - 5pm for 3 month temporary role.

To be a successful candidate you must have basic DBS and be able to deliver an effective, efficient, administrative service that is flexible to meet the needs of operational teams to enable the service to achieve agreed service objectives. - Providing a range of administrative services, utilising organisational policies, procedures and digital system, including providing professional front of house services to welcome internal and external visitors, ensuring visitors experience is welcoming and professional to reflect our brand and values - Undertaking the full range of activities associated with the management of business meetings, through efficient and effective planning to involve notifying participants, organising venues (including use of digital technology), provision of refreshments, agenda preparation, minuting and progress chasing agenda items and follow up actions.
You will be available immediately and be able to provide written references and pass a DBS disclosure. Well presented, approachable and with excellent speaking skills. Apply today for more information!

We are committed to fair and inclusive recruitment. All applicants will be considered on the basis of their skills, experience, qualifications and ability to perform the role, and no applicant will be treated less favourably because of a protected characteristic under the Equality Act 2010.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Finance Assistant (Accounts and Billing) Location: Watford (Hybrid: 3 days in office, 2 days working from home)
Contract Type: Temp to Perm
Availability: Immediately available candidates only
Salary Range: £32,000 to £35,000 per annum

Role Purpose
To support the day-to-day operation of the finance function through accurate transaction processing, reconciliations, customer billing, and collections. The role maintains accurate financial records, resolves routine queries, and supports the wider finance team, managing routine work independently with appropriate review and escalation of complex matters.

Key Responsibilities
- Process supplier invoices, checking that the required approvals are in place and applying accurate nominal ledger coding.
- Process employee expenses, checking coding and uploading transactions into the finance system.
- Process credit card expenses, ensuring accurate nominal coding and application of established VAT treatments.
- Record bank receipts and payments in Sage, complete bank reconciliations, and investigate or escalate outstanding differences.
- Maintain subscription billing and collection records, ensuring that direct debit mandates in GoCardless and payment arrangements in Stripe align with invoices in the relevant billing systems, including Stripe, Naviga, and Xero.
- Monitor failed customer payments and follow the agreed process to resolve collection issues.
- Allocate customer receipts from the bank account to invoices in Naviga and investigate unallocated cash.
- Reconcile billing, payment-provider, and accounting records to bank receipts, investigating missing allocations, duplicate entries, and unexplained differences.
- Manage the finance inbox, responding to and resolving routine queries and referring matters to the appropriate colleague where required.
- Prepare national statistics survey responses, coordinating review of unusual definitions or matters requiring judgement.
- Maintain clear supporting records and follow up unresolved items to completion.
- Assist the wider finance team with duties and ad hoc projects consistent with the scope of the role.

Scope and Accountability
Manage routine processing, reconciliations, and queries independently within agreed procedures and deadlines. Escalate complex accounting or VAT matters and issues requiring approval to the appropriate finance colleague.
Person Specification
Essential Experience, Knowledge, and Skills
- Relevant practical finance experience covering purchase ledger, expenses, customer receipts, and bank reconciliations, with the ability to manage routine work with normal supervision.
- Sound working knowledge of bookkeeping, including double-entry principles and the relationship between invoices, credit notes, payments, receipts, and ledger balances.
- Experience investigating reconciliation differences, payment discrepancies, and unallocated receipts, with appropriate follow-up and escalation.
- Ability to apply established nominal and VAT coding and recognise transactions requiring technical review.
- Confidence comparing and reconciling data across accounting, billing, and payment systems.
- Practical Excel skills, including filters, lookups, SUMIFS, and duplicate checks.
- Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to resolve queries with suppliers, customers, and colleagues.
- Strong attention to detail, organisation, and ability to manage recurring deadlines and competing priorities.
- Sound judgement about when to resolve an issue independently and when to seek approval or technical support.

Qualifications
- AAT Level 3 completed or in progress, or equivalent practical knowledge and experience.

Desirable Experience and Skills
- Experience in a subscription or recurring billing environment.
- Experience using GoCardless or Stripe for collections and reconciliation.
- Experience using Sage or Xero, and familiarity with Naviga.
- Experience working across multiple finance or billing systems and following up failed payments.
- Experience completing Office for National Statistics surveys or similar business returns.
- Ability to use Excel pivot tables.
